headline: OpenAI Cut Off a Billion-Dollar Customer to Avoid Elon Musk
context: OpenAI recently estimated its Cursor partnership would make more than $1 billion in revenue a year, WIRED has learned. It still walked away after Elon Musk’s SpaceX acquired the AI coding startup.
